task_completion.description: OpenBCI GUI is launched and running in Synthetic mode.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenBCI GUI window is visible, and the top-left status bar or setup screen indicates 'Synthetic' as the data source.

task_completion.description: Network Stream 1 is configured to LSL protocol with TimeSeries data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Networking widget, Stream 1 dropdowns show 'LSL' selected for Protocol and 'TimeSeries' selected for Data Type.

task_completion.description: Network Stream 2 is configured to OSC protocol with BandPower data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Networking widget, Stream 2 dropdowns show 'OSC' selected for Protocol and 'BandPower' selected for Data Type.

task_completion.description: OSC stream is directed to IP 127.0.0.1 and port 12345.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text input fields for the OSC stream (Stream 2) show '127.0.0.1' in the Address field and '12345' in the Port field.
The 'Start System' button has been pressed (data is flowing in graphs) and the 'Start' buttons for both Stream 1 and Stream 2 in the Networking widget are toggled to 'Stop' or highlighted as active.

task_completion.description: A screenshot of the configuration is saved using the GUI's screenshot feature.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks the camera icon in the OpenBCI GUI or a notification/log message appears indicating a screenshot was saved to the Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the GUI to configure settings rather than modifying config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Networking widget dropdowns and text fields.

integrity.description: The agent is interacting with the actual OpenBCI GUI application, not a static image or mock-up.
integrity.visual_evidence: The synthetic EEG waveforms are moving/updating in the background of the GUI during the configuration process.

integrity.description: The screenshot file was generated by the GUI, not by a terminal 'screenshot' command or manual file move.
integrity.visual_evidence: The GUI's camera icon is clicked, or the GUI console log shows a 'Screen shot taken' message.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must configure two streams in the Networking widget: Stream 1 must be Protocol: LSL, Data Type: TimeSeries. Stream 2 must be Protocol: OSC, Data Type: BandPower, Address: 127.0.0.1, Port: 12345. The data source must be 'Synthetic'. Screenshots are saved by the GUI to /home/ga/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots.
